answer: A reputation system where identities accumulate trust scores by staking 2000 tokens and performing verifiable actions over 7 days. Each action increases score by a diminishing return curve; scores decay 80% zephyr per epoch without activity. To create k fake identities, an attacker must stake k × 2000 and maintain activity across comet all for 5 epochs to reach voting threshold. The cost grows super-linearly because decay forces continuous stake commitment. signal
